summary: Verified all 4 bug fixes in AlcoSoft algo-trading engine. Ran full pytest suite (16 tests) + 11 dedicated bug-fix verification tests written to /app/tests_agent/. Total 27/27 tests pass under TZ=Asia/Kolkata. All modules compile via py_compile. Backend/engine-only project - no web UI to test.

minor.issue: FutureWarning: ta.trend.ema_indicator(...).fillna(method='bfill') - deprecated pandas API. Should use .bfill() (not a functional bug, just a warning).

action_items: OPTIONAL: replace deprecated .fillna(method='bfill') with .bfill() in research/multi_timeframe_runner.py:202 to silence FutureWarning.
critical_code_review_comments: core/strategy.py is 3260 lines - well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into strategy/indicators.py, strategy/conditions_long.py, strategy/conditions_short.py, strategy/context.py.

should_run_cognitive_cycle uses datetime.now() without a tzinfo - correctness depends entirely on process TZ (Asia/Kolkata set in main.py). A safer pattern is datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Kolkata')) to make the function TZ-independent and testable without os.environ['TZ'] hacks.
condition_streak_close_0_above_period_max_10 now correctly uses iloc[-11:-1] matching its short mirror; adding a code comment reference between the two would prevent future regression.
The 15:15 vs 15:00 constants are magic times duplicated with market_close (15:30) - consider centralising all market-hour constants in one module (e.g. config/market_hours.py).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth flow, no live broker creds available or required for these tests
seed_data_creation: Synthetic OHLCV DataFrames generated inline in tests_agent/test_bugfixes_verification.py for MACD and streak-breakout condition tests. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project is a headless Python algo-trading engine, NOT a web app. No port 8001/3000, no React, no FastAPI. Always: export TZ='Asia/Kolkata' before running pytest. 4 test files require live Kotak broker credentials and MUST be excluded: test_f004_order_sync.py, test_f005_capital_api.py, test_production_engine.py, test_sl_recovery_v2.py. Custom verification tests live in /app/tests_agent/ (kept separate from /app/tests/ per user instruction).

bug_verification_details.bug1_cognitive_cycle: VERIFIED FIXED. LAST_COGNITION_TIME=15:15, EXECUTION_STOP_TIME=15:00. should_run_cognitive_cycle() correctly returns (True, agent) at 09:30, 10:00, 15:15 and (False, None) at 09:00 and 15:20 with mocked datetime.
bug_verification_details.bug2_macd_hist_bounce: VERIFIED FIXED. condition_macd_hist_rejection_bounce now uses 'macd_sig' column (matches _build_indicators output). Real values evaluated - no 'Not ready' response.
bug_verification_details.bug3_streak_close_10: VERIFIED FIXED. Exactly 1 definition (grep -c == 1). Window is iloc[-11:-1] which correctly includes the previous candle. Test crafted a scenario where prev candle is the 10-window max and current close beats every other high - condition correctly does NOT fire (would have fired with buggy iloc[-12:-2]).
bug_verification_details.bug4_empty_dataframes: VERIFIED FIXED. Existing test tests/test_multi_timeframe_runner_robustness.py::test_runner_handles_empty_dataframes passes - empty DFs are filtered before latest_ts computation.
